name: Brain Coffee
summary:
Step into the most exclusive coffee house in the universe: your own. Brain Coffee VR is a premium wellness & entertainment experience
for Meta Quest. A black-and-gold futuristic lounge where the coffee ritual
becomes audiovisual sessions of energy, focus and motivation — rhythmic
music, a guiding voice, golden steam, and a holographic brain that lights up
with your progress.
